description: This PHP source file defines a class 'LDAPServerConfig' used for representing LDAP server configuration parameters within the OrangeHRM testing namespace. It includes properties for host, port, encryption, admin DN and password, and configuration admin DN and password, along with a static method to instantiate the class from an array.

classes.name: LDAPServerConfig
classes.description: A class representing LDAP server configuration details with properties for connection parameters and a static method to create an instance from an array.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates an LDAPServerConfig instance from an associative array of server configuration parameters.
